finalText:
**Migrated 12 files, 36 call sites.** All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

`node --check` passes on every file.

Left alone on purpose:

| What | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)` | Vendored copy. Header says do not edit. |
| 25 `cache.query` calls | Different object. Takes a cache key, not SQL. |

Next: swap `legacy-orm` upstream or wrap it, then delete `db.query`.
